page.notes: The scan is very dark, blurred and bled through from the reverse side, so almost every line is unreadable. Only a few Latin words can be made out with some confidence (Aquilonem, Nempe alter, Septentrionibus, Graeci). The Greek is not legible enough to copy, so each Greek line is marked as illegible rather than guessed. The page number "34" at top left and the running head are only partly legible. The paragraph breaks and line counts are estimates. Marginal notes and the lower verse lines could not be separated from the show-through, so they are not transcribed. A higher-resolution or better-contrast scan would allow a proper transcription.
